references.text: The regulation concerning the sin offering with a male goat for a leader who has sinned, showing the background for using a male goat as a sin offering.
A male goat as a sin offering at the dedication of the tabernacle, parallel to the dedication offerings from the tribal leaders.
Male goats used as sin offerings on the Day of Atonement, highlighting the central role of the goat in the sin offering.
A male goat as a sin offering for unintentional sins committed by the entire congregation.
A male goat as a sin offering during monthly festival sacrifices, showing the continued use of goats for sin offerings.
Male goats as sin offerings during King Hezekiah's temple cleansing, confirming the enduring practice.
Male goats as sin offerings at the dedication of the second temple, demonstrating continuity in sacrificial practices.
